import cv2, numpy as np
from PIL import Image

f0 = np.array(Image.open('../first_frame.png'))
lum = f0.mean(2).astype(np.uint8)
H,W = lum.shape

# Statue candidate region: bright object right-of-center
mask = (lum > 48).astype(np.uint8)
# restrict to statue zone
zone = np.zeros_like(mask); zone[55:130, 128:195] = 1
mask &= zone
n, lab, stats, cent = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(mask, 8)
# print components sorted
comps = sorted([(stats[i,cv2.CC_STAT_AREA], i, stats[i].tolist(), cent[i].tolist()) for i in range(1,n)], reverse=True)
for a,i,s,c in comps[:6]:
    print('comp',i,'area',a,'bbox[x,y,w,h]',s[:4],'cent',c)

# soft alpha via luminance ramp within bbox of largest
i = comps[0][1]
obj = (lab==i).astype(np.uint8)
obj = cv2.morphologyEx(obj, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, np.ones((3,3),np.uint8))
ys,xs = np.where(obj)
print('statue hard bbox x',xs.min(),xs.max(),'y',ys.min(),ys.max(),'center',(xs.min()+xs.max())/2,(ys.min()+ys.max())/2)

# Platform: very dark ellipse under statue; look at darkness in lower region
dark = (lum < 12).astype(np.uint8)
pzone = np.zeros_like(dark); pzone[100:144, 90:230]=1
n2,lab2,st2,c2 = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(dark&pzone,8)
comps2 = sorted([(st2[i,cv2.CC_STAT_AREA],i,st2[i].tolist(),c2[i].tolist()) for i in range(1,n2)], reverse=True)
for a,i,s,c in comps2[:6]:
    print('darkcomp',i,'area',a,'bbox',s[:4],'cent',c)

# row brightness profile near platform to find disk edges
for y in [108,112,116,120,125,130,135,140]:
    row = lum[y]
    xs = np.where(row<10)[0]
    if len(xs):
        # largest contiguous run
        runs=[]; s=xs[0]; p=xs[0]
        for x in xs[1:]:
            if x-p>2: runs.append((s,p)); s=x
            p=x
        runs.append((s,p))
        runs.sort(key=lambda r:r[1]-r[0],reverse=True)
        print('y',y,'darkest run',runs[0],'mean row',row.mean().round(1))

zone=np.zeros_like(m); zone[50:144,125:195]=1

m=cv2.dilate(m,np.ones((7,7),np.uint8),iterations=2)
